commands.name: install
commands.description: Install dependencies exactly as the lockfile pins them.

commands.name: format
commands.description: Apply the repository's own formatting. Declared as bootstrap and ordered after install, because it runs prettier from node_modules and a tree that has not installed cannot format. It writes to the tree — that is the point, and it is why it is not a gate.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: The bar: typecheck, test, lint. One script, so the gate the belt runs and the gate CI runs cannot drift apart (S1).
